title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
summary: 從雙 T 梁斷面與屋頂荷載路徑出發，計算預力反拱與長期撓度、缺口梁端吊筋與水平束制力、翼板連接器的隔板剪力，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定與連接完成、反拱差與屋面排水、放鬆時端部應力與出廠品質、現場載重試驗，最後談屋面防水與連接器腐蝕、改裝開孔與交接，並以美國職業安全衛生署對邁阿密戴德學院停車場與 Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁事故的調查報告對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the double-tee section and the roof load path, compute prestress camber and long-term deflection, dapped-end hangers and horizontal restraint forces, and diaphragm shear on flange connectors, then handle temporary stability and completed connections during erection, camber differential and roof drainage, end stresses at transfer and plant quality, and in-situ load testing, and finally roof waterproofing and connector corrosion, alterations and handover, compared with OSHA investigation reports on the Miami Dade College garage and Montgomery Mall double-tee incidents.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：教學雙 T 梁寬 3.0 m、高 800 mm、跨度 24 m，A = 450,000 mm²、I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm。自重 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa），加附加靜載 0.5 kPa 與屋頂活載 1.0 kPa，w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m。配置 12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、偏心 e ≈ 408 mm，以 f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa、f'c = 35 MPa 估計 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比約 0.80。放鬆時 P_i ≈ 2,016 kN：反拱約 65.7 mm、自重撓度約 51.7 mm，淨反拱約 14 mm；梁端頂部拉應力約 3.5 MPa，超過 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，需脫黏或折線配置。長期淨反拱只剩約 2 mm，排水坡度須由支承高程提供，並以雨水荷載約 0.74 kPa 檢核。每根腹肋端部反力約 117 kN，缺口吊筋約需 373 mm²。若日後切斷 2 股鋼絞線，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力約 5.2 MPa 會開裂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a teaching double tee 3.0 m wide and 800 mm deep spans 24 m, with A = 450,000 mm², I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴ and y_b ≈ 508 mm. Self-weight is 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa); with 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load and 1.0 kPa roof live load, w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Twelve 15.2 mm strands at e ≈ 408 mm, with f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa and f'c = 35 MPa, give φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and a demand ratio of about 0.80. At release P_i ≈ 2,016 kN: camber about 65.7 mm against self-weight deflection about 51.7 mm, a net of about 14 mm; top tension at the ends is about 3.5 MPa, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so strands must be debonded or harped. Long-term net camber is only about 2 mm, so drainage slope must come from bearing elevations, checked for a rain load of about 0.74 kPa. Each stem end reacts about 117 kN, needing about 373 mm² of dap hanger steel. If 2 strands are later cut, φM_n falls to about 1,471 kN·m, the demand ratio rises to about 0.96 and service bottom tension of about 5.2 MPa cracks the member. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」與「預力反拱與長期撓度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" and "Prestress camber and long-term deflection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙 T 梁斷面」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-tee section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。屋頂荷載包括自重、防水與設備的附加靜載、活載或雪載與積水雨載，經翼板傳到腹肋，再經腹肋端部擱置在倒 T 梁、牆或牛腿上的承壓墊。翼板之間以焊接連接器相連，使整片屋頂成為傳遞風與地震力的隔板。這個系統輕、快、跨度大，但每一個端部與連接器都是關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙 T 梁斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side. Roof loads, namely self-weight, superimposed dead load from roofing and equipment, live or snow load and ponding rain, pass from the flange into the stems and then through bearing pads at the stem ends onto inverted-tee beams, walls or corbels. Flanges are joined by welded connectors so that the whole roof acts as a diaphragm carrying wind and earthquake forces. The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-tee section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙 T 梁斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-tee section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙 T 梁斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-tee section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學斷面：翼板 3,000×50 mm、兩腹肋平均寬 200 mm 高 750 mm，總高 800 mm，A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm²，自重 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa）。附加靜載 0.5 kPa、屋頂活載 1.0 kPa、跨度 24 m：w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙 T 梁斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-tee section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計與機電要在初期就確定屋頂設備的位置與重量，並在雙 T 梁配置圖上標示允許集中荷載區；後續新增設備必須由結構技師檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and services teams should fix rooftop equipment locations and weights early and mark allowable concentrated-load zones on the double-tee layout; any later equipment must be checked by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-tee section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預力鋼絞線與反拱」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strands and camber” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。之後混凝土潛變使反拱隨時間增長，但預力損失與附加靜載又會抵銷一部分。對屋頂而言，反拱關係到排水坡度、防水層、與相鄰構件的高差，以及屋面設備與天窗的安裝。PCI 設計手冊提供以乘數估算安裝時與長期撓度的簡化方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預力鋼絞線與反拱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. Creep then increases camber with time, partly offset by prestress losses and superimposed dead load. For a roof, camber affects drainage slope, waterproofing, level differences with adjacent members, and the fit of equipment and skylights. The PCI Design Handbook offers a simplified multiplier method to estimate deflections at erection and in the long term. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strands and camber” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strands and camber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度
knowledge.text: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。之後混凝土潛變使反拱隨時間增長，但預力損失與附加靜載又會抵銷一部分。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預力反拱與長期撓度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prestress camber and long-term deflection" is correct?

雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。

Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.

quiz.explanationEn: Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strands and camber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。反拱 P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm，自重撓度 ≈ 51.7 mm，放鬆淨反拱約 14 mm；以長期乘數 2.45、2.70 與附加靜載 3.0 計，最終淨反拱只剩約 2 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN. Camber P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm and self-weight deflection ≈ 51.7 mm, a net release camber of about 14 mm; with long-term multipliers of 2.45, 2.70 and 3.0 for superimposed dead load, the final net camber is only about 2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Camber P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm and self-weight deflection ≈ 51.7 mm, a net release camber of about 14 mm; with long-term multipliers of 2.45, 2.70 and 3.0 for superimposed dead load, the final net camber is only about 2 mm. steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力鋼絞線與反拱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strands and camber” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：屋面排水坡度應由支承高程或構件傾斜提供，不應只靠反拱；圖說中標示預估安裝時反拱與允許差值，並要求相鄰雙 T 梁的堆置時間盡量一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Roof drainage slope should come from bearing elevations or sloping members rather than camber alone; drawings should show predicted erection camber and allowable differences, and adjacent tees should have similar storage ages where possible.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。
knowledge.textEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 屋面排水坡度應由支承高程或構件傾斜提供，不應只靠反拱；圖說中標示預估安裝時反拱與允許差值，並要求相鄰雙 T 梁的堆置時間盡量一致。
knowledge.textEn: Roof drainage slope should come from bearing elevations or sloping members rather than camber alone; drawings should show predicted erection camber and allowable differences, and adjacent tees should have similar storage ages where possible.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預力反拱與長期撓度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prestress camber and long-term deflection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。
屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve.
Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees.
quiz.explanation: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strands and camber” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：PCI 設計手冊提供以乘數估算安裝時與長期撓度的簡化方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The PCI Design Handbook offers a simplified multiplier method to estimate deflections at erection and in the long term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力」與「翼板連接器與屋頂隔板」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint" and "Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「端部缺口與承壓墊」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dapped end and bearing pad” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 為了讓屋頂高程平順，雙 T 梁腹肋端部常做成缺口（dapped end），擱置在倒 T 梁或牆的承壓墊上。缺口的內角是應力集中處，剪力必須靠吊筋把力從下方的缺口段傳到上方全斷面，並配置水平鋼筋抵抗端部水平力。承壓墊讓構件因乾縮、潛變與溫度變化而自由伸縮；若端部被焊死或承壓墊被灌漿填滿，這些體積變化會被束制，產生水平拉力，使缺口內角開裂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「端部缺口與承壓墊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To keep roof levels smooth, stem ends are often dapped and seated on bearing pads on inverted-tee beams or walls. The re-entrant corner of a dap concentrates stress, so hanger reinforcement must lift shear from the reduced nib into the full section above, with horizontal bars resisting end tension. Bearing pads let the member move freely with shrinkage, creep and temperature change; if ends are welded rigidly or pads are grouted solid, these volume changes are restrained and create horizontal tension that cracks the dap corner. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dapped end and bearing pad” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每根腹肋端部反力 V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN，取水平束制力 N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each stem end carries V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN, with a horizontal restraint force taken as N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「端部缺口與承壓墊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dapped end and bearing pad”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力
knowledge.titleEn: Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint
knowledge.text: 為了讓屋頂高程平順，雙 T 梁腹肋端部常做成缺口（dapped end），擱置在倒 T 梁或牆的承壓墊上。缺口的內角是應力集中處，剪力必須靠吊筋把力從下方的缺口段傳到上方全斷面，並配置水平鋼筋抵抗端部水平力。
knowledge.textEn: To keep roof levels smooth, stem ends are often dapped and seated on bearing pads on inverted-tee beams or walls. The re-entrant corner of a dap concentrates stress, so hanger reinforcement must lift shear from the reduced nib into the full section above, with horizontal bars resisting end tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint" is correct?
options: 為了讓屋頂高程平順，雙 T 梁腹肋端部常做成缺口（dapped end），擱置在倒 T 梁或牆的承壓墊上。
雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
optionsEn: To keep roof levels smooth, stem ends are often dapped and seated on bearing pads on inverted-tee beams or walls.
Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
quiz.explanation: 為了讓屋頂高程平順，雙 T 梁腹肋端部常做成缺口（dapped end），擱置在倒 T 梁或牆的承壓墊上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: To keep roof levels smooth, stem ends are often dapped and seated on bearing pads on inverted-tee beams or walls. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端部缺口與承壓墊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dapped end and bearing pad” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每根腹肋端部反力 V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN，取水平束制力 N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN。缺口吊筋 A_sh = V_u/(φ·f_y) = 117,400/(0.75×420) ≈ 373 mm²，可用 2 支 D16（2×199 = 398 mm²），並另配水平筋抵抗 N_u。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each stem end carries V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN, with a horizontal restraint force taken as N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN. Dap hanger steel A_sh = V_u/(φ·f_y) = 117,400/(0.75×420) ≈ 373 mm², met by 2 D16 bars (2×199 = 398 mm²), with separate horizontal bars for N_u. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置；安裝時量測實際擱置長度與承壓墊位置，確認墊片未偏出或被擠壓變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting; at erection measure actual seating length and pad position, confirming pads are not displaced or squeezed out.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Dap hanger steel A_sh = V_u/(φ·f_y) = 117,400/(0.75×420) ≈ 373 mm², met by 2 D16 bars (2×199 = 398 mm²), with separate horizontal bars for N_u. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

每根腹肋端部反力 V_u = 19.56×24/2/2 ≈ 117 kN，取水平束制力 N_u = 0.2·V_u ≈ 23.5 kN。

steps.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端部缺口與承壓墊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dapped end and bearing pad” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置；安裝時量測實際擱置長度與承壓墊位置，確認墊片未偏出或被擠壓變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting; at erection measure actual seating length and pad position, confirming pads are not displaced or squeezed out. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：端部連接應區分哪一端允許滑動、焊接件設計成可容納體積變化，並在圖說中禁止以灌漿填滿承壓墊周圍；缺口內角的裂縫寬度列入定期檢查項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: End connections should distinguish which end may slide, with welded hardware designed to accommodate volume change, and drawings should forbid grouting solid around bearing pads; crack width at dap corners belongs in periodic inspections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺口內角在多年溫度循環下出現斜裂縫並逐漸擴大，若吊筋不足或錨定不夠，缺口段可能突然剪斷，整片雙 T 梁一端掉落；承壓墊老化或移位使腹肋直接壓在混凝土邊緣，邊緣剝落後擱置長度不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Diagonal cracks at the dap corner grow over years of thermal cycling, and with too little hanger steel or anchorage the nib can shear off suddenly, dropping one end of the tee; aged or displaced pads let the stem bear directly on the concrete edge, which spalls until seating becomes inadequate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置；安裝時量測實際擱置長度與承壓墊位置，確認墊片未偏出或被擠壓變形。
knowledge.textEn: Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting; at erection measure actual seating length and pad position, confirming pads are not displaced or squeezed out.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 端部連接應區分哪一端允許滑動、焊接件設計成可容納體積變化，並在圖說中禁止以灌漿填滿承壓墊周圍；缺口內角的裂縫寬度列入定期檢查項目。
knowledge.textEn: End connections should distinguish which end may slide, with welded hardware designed to accommodate volume change, and drawings should forbid grouting solid around bearing pads; crack width at dap corners belongs in periodic inspections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。
檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting.
quiz.explanation: 檢查缺口細部圖的吊筋、水平筋與錨定長度是否符合 PCI 設計手冊的缺口設計方法，工廠澆置前逐片檢查鋼筋位置；安裝時量測實際擱置長度與承壓墊位置，確認墊片未偏出或被擠壓變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that hanger bars, horizontal bars and anchorage in the dap detail follow the PCI Design Handbook dapped-end method, and inspect bar placement for every unit before casting; at erection measure actual seating length and pad position, confirming pads are not displaced or squeezed out. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端部缺口與承壓墊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dapped end and bearing pad” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺口內角在多年溫度循環下出現斜裂縫並逐漸擴大，若吊筋不足或錨定不夠，缺口段可能突然剪斷，整片雙 T 梁一端掉落；承壓墊老化或移位使腹肋直接壓在混凝土邊緣，邊緣剝落後擱置長度不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Diagonal cracks at the dap corner grow over years of thermal cycling, and with too little hanger steel or anchorage the nib can shear off suddenly, dropping one end of the tee; aged or displaced pads let the stem bear directly on the concrete edge, which spalls until seating becomes inadequate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：承壓墊讓構件因乾縮、潛變與溫度變化而自由伸縮；若端部被焊死或承壓墊被灌漿填滿，這些體積變化會被束制，產生水平拉力，使缺口內角開裂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bearing pads let the member move freely with shrinkage, creep and temperature change; if ends are welded rigidly or pads are grouted solid, these volume changes are restrained and create horizontal tension that cracks the dap corner.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「缺口梁端、承壓與水平束制力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dapped ends, bearing and horizontal restraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 缺口內角在多年溫度循環下出現斜裂縫並逐漸擴大，若吊筋不足或錨定不夠，缺口段可能突然剪斷，整片雙 T 梁一端掉落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
optionsEn: Diagonal cracks at the dap corner grow over years of thermal cycling, and with too little hanger steel or anchorage the nib can shear off suddenly, dropping one end of the tee.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
quiz.explanation: 缺口內角在多年溫度循環下出現斜裂縫並逐漸擴大，若吊筋不足或錨定不夠，缺口段可能突然剪斷，整片雙 T 梁一端掉落；承壓墊老化或移位使腹肋直接壓在混凝土邊緣，邊緣剝落後擱置長度不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagonal cracks at the dap corner grow over years of thermal cycling, and with too little hanger steel or anchorage the nib can shear off suddenly, dropping one end of the tee; aged or displaced pads let the stem bear directly on the concrete edge, which spalls until seating becomes inadequate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 翼板連接器與屋頂隔板：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「翼板焊接連接器」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flange weld connectors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 沒有現澆面層的雙 T 梁屋頂，隔板作用完全依賴相鄰翼板之間的焊接連接器與周邊弦材：連接器傳遞翼板接縫上的剪力，同時讓相鄰構件的撓度協調，避免集中荷載只由一片雙 T 梁承受。弦材與集力構件把隔板力送到抗側力牆或構架。連接器間距、預埋鋼件的錨定與現場焊接品質，決定了屋頂能否在風與地震中作為一個整體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「翼板焊接連接器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In an untopped double-tee roof, diaphragm action relies entirely on welded connectors between adjacent flanges and on perimeter chords: connectors transfer shear along flange joints and make adjacent members deflect together, so a concentrated load is not carried by one tee alone. Chords and collectors deliver diaphragm force to lateral walls or frames. Connector spacing, anchorage of embedded hardware and field weld quality decide whether the roof works as one unit in wind and earthquakes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Flange weld connectors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 48 m × 24 m roof weighs (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN, and the diaphragm design force is 0.2W ≈ 945 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「翼板焊接連接器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Flange weld connectors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 沒有現澆面層的雙 T 梁屋頂，隔板作用完全依賴相鄰翼板之間的焊接連接器與周邊弦材：連接器傳遞翼板接縫上的剪力，同時讓相鄰構件的撓度協調，避免集中荷載只由一片雙 T 梁承受。弦材與集力構件把隔板力送到抗側力牆或構架。

Chords and collectors deliver diaphragm force to lateral walls or frames.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「翼板連接器與屋頂隔板」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm" is correct?
options: 雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
沒有現澆面層的雙 T 梁屋頂，隔板作用完全依賴相鄰翼板之間的焊接連接器與周邊弦材：連接器傳遞翼板接縫上的剪力，同時讓相鄰構件的撓度協調，避免集中荷載只由一片雙 T 梁承受。
雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。
optionsEn: Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.

In an untopped double-tee roof, diaphragm action relies entirely on welded connectors between adjacent flanges and on perimeter chords: connectors transfer shear along flange joints and make adjacent members deflect together, so a concentrated load is not carried by one tee alone.
Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
quiz.explanation: 沒有現澆面層的雙 T 梁屋頂，隔板作用完全依賴相鄰翼板之間的焊接連接器與周邊弦材：連接器傳遞翼板接縫上的剪力，同時讓相鄰構件的撓度協調，避免集中荷載只由一片雙 T 梁承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In an untopped double-tee roof, diaphragm action relies entirely on welded connectors between adjacent flanges and on perimeter chords: connectors transfer shear along flange joints and make adjacent members deflect together, so a concentrated load is not carried by one tee alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 翼板連接器與屋頂隔板：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「翼板焊接連接器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flange weld connectors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：屋頂 48 m × 24 m、重量 (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN，隔板設計力 0.2W ≈ 945 kN。隔板以兩端牆為支承，端部剪力 V = 945/2 ≈ 472 kN，沿 24 m 接縫的剪力流 q ≈ 472/24 ≈ 19.7 kN/m；連接器間距 1.5 m 時每個需約 29.5 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 48 m × 24 m roof weighs (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN, and the diaphragm design force is 0.2W ≈ 945 kN. Spanning between end walls, the diaphragm end shear is V = 945/2 ≈ 472 kN, a shear flow along the 24 m joint of q ≈ 472/24 ≈ 19.7 kN/m, so connectors at 1.5 m spacing each need about 29.5 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant; field welds are made by qualified welders to an approved procedure, every weld is visually checked for size and logged, and a sample is tested non-destructively.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: A 48 m × 24 m roof weighs (3.6+0.5)×1,152 m² ≈ 4,723 kN, and the diaphragm design force is 0.2W ≈ 945 kN. Spanning between end walls, the diaphragm end shear is V = 945/2 ≈ 472 kN, a shear flow along the 24 m joint of q ≈ 472/24 ≈ 19.7 kN/m, so connectors at 1.5 m spacing each need about 29.5 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm", which statement holds?

steps.title: 翼板連接器與屋頂隔板：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「翼板焊接連接器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flange weld connectors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant; field welds are made by qualified welders to an approved procedure, every weld is visually checked for size and logged, and a sample is tested non-destructively. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：連接器配置圖要標示每一個連接器的位置與編號，焊接完成以噴漆或標籤標記並由檢驗人員簽認；未完成連接器的區域不得堆放材料或作為設備通道。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The connector layout should number every connector, and completed welds are marked with paint or tags and signed by the inspector; no materials may be stockpiled and no equipment may travel over areas with incomplete connectors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連接器漏焊或焊道過小時，地震或強風下翼板接縫被撕開，屋頂分裂成獨立的條狀構件，牆頂失去側向支撐而外傾；連接器間距過大，則屋頂集中荷載使相鄰翼板高差增加，防水層被拉裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missed or undersized connector welds let flange joints tear open in an earthquake or strong wind, splitting the roof into independent strips and leaving wall tops unbraced to lean outward; widely spaced connectors let concentrated loads open level differences between flanges, tearing the waterproofing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant; field welds are made by qualified welders to an approved procedure, every weld is visually checked for size and logged, and a sample is tested non-destructively.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 連接器配置圖要標示每一個連接器的位置與編號，焊接完成以噴漆或標籤標記並由檢驗人員簽認；未完成連接器的區域不得堆放材料或作為設備通道。
knowledge.textEn: The connector layout should number every connector, and completed welds are marked with paint or tags and signed by the inspector; no materials may be stockpiled and no equipment may travel over areas with incomplete connectors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「翼板連接器與屋頂隔板」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm"?
options: 核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
optionsEn: Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.
quiz.explanation: 核對連接器型式有試驗或計算證明的剪力與拉力容量，工廠檢查預埋件位置與錨筋；現場焊接由合格焊工依焊接程序施作，逐一目視檢查焊道尺寸並記錄，抽樣做非破壞檢測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that the connector type has tested or calculated shear and tension capacity, and check embed positions and anchor bars in the plant; field welds are made by qualified welders to an approved procedure, every weld is visually checked for size and logged, and a sample is tested non-destructively. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 翼板連接器與屋頂隔板：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「翼板焊接連接器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flange weld connectors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連接器漏焊或焊道過小時，地震或強風下翼板接縫被撕開，屋頂分裂成獨立的條狀構件，牆頂失去側向支撐而外傾；連接器間距過大，則屋頂集中荷載使相鄰翼板高差增加，防水層被拉裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missed or undersized connector welds let flange joints tear open in an earthquake or strong wind, splitting the roof into independent strips and leaving wall tops unbraced to lean outward; widely spaced connectors let concentrated loads open level differences between flanges, tearing the waterproofing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：連接器間距、預埋鋼件的錨定與現場焊接品質，決定了屋頂能否在風與地震中作為一個整體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Connector spacing, anchorage of embedded hardware and field weld quality decide whether the roof works as one unit in wind and earthquakes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「翼板連接器與屋頂隔板」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flange connectors and the roof diaphragm" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
連接器漏焊或焊道過小時，地震或強風下翼板接縫被撕開，屋頂分裂成獨立的條狀構件，牆頂失去側向支撐而外傾。
雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Missed or undersized connector welds let flange joints tear open in an earthquake or strong wind, splitting the roof into independent strips and leaving wall tops unbraced to lean outward.
Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
quiz.explanation: 連接器漏焊或焊道過小時，地震或強風下翼板接縫被撕開，屋頂分裂成獨立的條狀構件，牆頂失去側向支撐而外傾；連接器間距過大，則屋頂集中荷載使相鄰翼板高差增加，防水層被拉裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Missed or undersized connector welds let flange joints tear open in an earthquake or strong wind, splitting the roof into independent strips and leaving wall tops unbraced to lean outward; widely spaced connectors let concentrated loads open level differences between flanges, tearing the waterproofing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成」與「反拱差調整與屋面排水」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections" and "Camber differential and roof drainage": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊點與端部焊接完成」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting points and completed end welds” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙 T 梁吊裝快速，但在端部與翼板連接完成前，每一片都只是擱置在承壓墊上的獨立構件，支承它的柱、倒 T 梁與牆也可能尚未灌漿或焊接完成。美國職業安全衛生署的調查顯示：2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場倒塌，起因是一根柱底未灌漿而由墊片承壓，柱荷載約 1,360 kips 超過估計承壓能力 839 至 1,050 kips；2016 年重建工地則有兩片雙 T 梁在相鄰構件調整墊片時倒塌，當天放置的 7 片中有 4 片只有一處或沒有完成規定的 4 處端部焊接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊點與端部焊接完成」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Double tees go up quickly, but until end and flange connections are complete each unit is just a member resting on pads, and the columns, inverted tees and walls supporting it may themselves be ungrouted or unwelded. OSHA investigations show that the 2012 Miami Dade College garage collapse began at a column whose base was never grouted and bore on shims, with a column load of about 1,360 kips exceeding an estimated bearing capacity of 839 to 1,050 kips; at the rebuilt garage in 2016, two tees fell while shims were adjusted on an adjacent member, and four of the seven placed that day had one or none of the four required end welds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting points and completed end welds” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN；吊索與水平夾角 60° 時吊索拉力 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN，乘動力係數 1.2 約 89.8 kN；若吊點要求 4 倍安全係數，極限能力須 ≥ 約 359 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each; at a 60° sling angle the sling tension is 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN, about 89.8 kN with a 1.2 dynamic factor, so with a required safety factor of 4 the insert needs an ultimate capacity of at least about 359 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊點與端部焊接完成」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting points and completed end welds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections
knowledge.text: 雙 T 梁吊裝快速，但在端部與翼板連接完成前，每一片都只是擱置在承壓墊上的獨立構件，支承它的柱、倒 T 梁與牆也可能尚未灌漿或焊接完成。美國職業安全衛生署的調查顯示：2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場倒塌，起因是一根柱底未灌漿而由墊片承壓，柱荷載約 1,360 kips 超過估計承壓能力 839 至 1,050 kips；2016 年重建工地則有兩片雙 T 梁在相鄰構件調整墊片時倒塌，當天放置的 7 片中有 4 片只有一處或沒有完成規定的 4 處端部焊接。
knowledge.textEn: Double tees go up quickly, but until end and flange connections are complete each unit is just a member resting on pads, and the columns, inverted tees and walls supporting it may themselves be ungrouted or unwelded. OSHA investigations show that the 2012 Miami Dade College garage collapse began at a column whose base was never grouted and bore on shims, with a column load of about 1,360 kips exceeding an estimated bearing capacity of 839 to 1,050 kips; at the rebuilt garage in 2016, two tees fell while shims were adjusted on an adjacent member, and four of the seven placed that day had one or none of the four required end welds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections" is correct?
options: 雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。
屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。
雙 T 梁吊裝快速，但在端部與翼板連接完成前，每一片都只是擱置在承壓墊上的獨立構件，支承它的柱、倒 T 梁與牆也可能尚未灌漿或焊接完成。
optionsEn: Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.
As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally.

Double tees go up quickly, but until end and flange connections are complete each unit is just a member resting on pads, and the columns, inverted tees and walls supporting it may themselves be ungrouted or unwelded.
quiz.explanation: 雙 T 梁吊裝快速，但在端部與翼板連接完成前，每一片都只是擱置在承壓墊上的獨立構件，支承它的柱、倒 T 梁與牆也可能尚未灌漿或焊接完成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Double tees go up quickly, but until end and flange connections are complete each unit is just a member resting on pads, and the columns, inverted tees and walls supporting it may themselves be ungrouted or unwelded. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊點與端部焊接完成」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting points and completed end welds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN；吊索與水平夾角 60° 時吊索拉力 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN，乘動力係數 1.2 約 89.8 kN；若吊點要求 4 倍安全係數，極限能力須 ≥ 約 359 kN。數值為教學假設，不是吊掛作業許可。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each; at a 60° sling angle the sling tension is 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN, about 89.8 kN with a 1.2 dynamic factor, so with a required safety factor of 4 the insert needs an ultimate capacity of at least about 359 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not a rigging permit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫列出每片雙 T 梁的重量、吊點與吊具、放置順序、每一階段需完成的端部與翼板焊接、支承柱與倒 T 梁的灌漿狀態，以及臨時支撐；每片放置後由檢驗人員確認焊接數量與位置，才允許放鬆吊鉤或在其上方繼續作業。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The erection plan lists weight, lifting points and rigging, placing order, the end and flange welds required at each stage, the grouting status of supporting columns and inverted tees, and temporary bracing; after each tee is placed an inspector confirms the number and location of welds before the hook is released or work continues above.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN；吊索與水平夾角 60° 時吊索拉力 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN，乘動力係數 1.2 約 89.8 kN；若吊點要求 4 倍安全係數，極限能力須 ≥ 約 359 kN。數值為教學假設，不是吊掛作業許可。
knowledge.textEn: A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each; at a 60° sling angle the sling tension is 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN, about 89.8 kN with a 1.2 dynamic factor, so with a required safety factor of 4 the insert needs an ultimate capacity of at least about 359 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not a rigging permit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN。

optionsEn: A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each.
A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 雙 T 梁自重 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN（約 26.4 t），四點吊掛，每點垂直 64.8 kN；吊索與水平夾角 60° 時吊索拉力 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN，乘動力係數 1.2 約 89.8 kN；若吊點要求 4 倍安全係數，極限能力須 ≥ 約 359 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A tee weighing 10.8 kN/m×24 m ≈ 259 kN (about 26.4 t) is lifted at four points, 64.8 kN vertical each; at a 60° sling angle the sling tension is 64.8/sin60° ≈ 74.8 kN, about 89.8 kN with a 1.2 dynamic factor, so with a required safety factor of 4 the insert needs an ultimate capacity of at least about 359 kN. steps.title: 吊裝順序、臨時穩定與連接完成：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence, temporary stability and completing connections: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊點與端部焊接完成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.objective: 說明「相鄰反拱差與排水坡」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adjacent camber difference and drainage slope” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 相鄰雙 T 梁因混凝土強度、放鬆時間與堆置天數不同，反拱可能相差十幾公釐，翼板接縫出現高低差。焊接連接器前必須先把高差拉平，通常以夾具、千斤頂或加載方式調整，強行焊接則會在連接器與翼板中留下應力。另一方面，雙 T 梁屋頂的長期淨反拱往往很小，屋面排水坡度若不足，暴雨時積水增加荷載，形成積水—撓度—更多積水的循環，因此屋頂的雨水荷載與排水設計和結構設計密不可分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「相鄰反拱差與排水坡」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Adjacent double tees can differ in camber by more than ten millimetres because of different concrete strength, release time and storage age, leaving steps at flange joints. These must be pulled level before connectors are welded, usually with clamps, jacks or surcharge, since forced welding locks stresses into connectors and flanges. Moreover, long-term net camber of a double-tee roof is often small, so with too little drainage slope a downpour ponds water, adding load in a ponding–deflection–more-ponding cycle; rain load and drainage design are therefore inseparable from the structural design of the roof. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Adjacent camber difference and drainage slope” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 ASCE 7 型式的雨水荷載 R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa（d 以 mm 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the ASCE 7 form of rain load, R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa with depths in mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相鄰反拱差與排水坡」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adjacent camber difference and drainage slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ASCE 7 型式的雨水荷載 R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa（d 以 mm 計）。主排水堵塞時到溢流口的靜水深 d_s = 50 mm、溢流水頭 d_h = 25 mm：R = 0.0098×75 ≈ 0.74 kPa，接近屋頂活載 1.0 kPa。前一單元的最終淨反拱只約 2 mm，坡度必須由支承高程提供。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the ASCE 7 form of rain load, R = 0.0098·(d_s + d_h) kPa with depths in mm. With a static head of d_s = 50 mm to the overflow when primary drains are blocked and a hydraulic head of d_h = 25 mm, R = 0.0098×75 ≈ 0.74 kPa, close to the 1.0 kPa roof live load. The final net camber from the previous unit is only about 2 mm, so slope must come from bearing elevations. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After erection, measure the level difference across every flange joint, recording adjustment method and final levels where tolerance is exceeded; after roofing, run a drainage test or inspect ponding after rain to confirm that primary drain and overflow levels match the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 反拱差調整與屋面排水：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相鄰反拱差與排水坡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adjacent camber difference and drainage slope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝後量測每條翼板接縫兩側高程差，超過允許值者記錄調整方式與調整後高程；屋面完成後做排水測試或在雨後檢查積水範圍，確認主排水與溢流口高程符合設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After erection, measure the level difference across every flange joint, recording adjustment method and final levels where tolerance is exceeded; after roofing, run a drainage test or inspect ponding after rain to confirm that primary drain and overflow levels match the design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Roof drainage must provide both primary drains and independent overflows, with overflow levels and rain-load assumptions written into the structural calculations; the installation specification should set allowable steps between adjacent members and adjustment methods, using controlled means such as jacks with a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以強力夾具或吊車壓平高差後立即焊接，連接器在溫度循環中疲勞斷裂；屋頂溢流口高於設計或被雜物堵住，暴雨時積水深度超過假設，雙 T 梁撓度增加又積更多水，嚴重時導致局部屋頂崩塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instructionEn: Forcing flanges level with heavy clamps or a crane and welding at once leads to connector fatigue fractures under thermal cycling; overflows set higher than designed or blocked by debris let ponding exceed the assumed depth in a downpour, so the tees deflect, collect more water and in severe cases part of the roof collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：另一方面，雙 T 梁屋頂的長期淨反拱往往很小，屋面排水坡度若不足，暴雨時積水增加荷載，形成積水—撓度—更多積水的循環，因此屋頂的雨水荷載與排水設計和結構設計密不可分。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」與「現場撓度量測與載重試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer checks and plant quality control" and "Field deflection survey and load testing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「放鬆時端部應力」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer stress at ends” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預力放鬆是雙 T 梁最危險的時刻之一：混凝土強度還低，跨中有自重彎矩抵銷預力偏心，但梁端附近沒有自重彎矩，底部壓應力與頂部拉應力都最大。若頂部拉應力超過容許值，翼板會開裂，因此常把部分鋼絞線在端部脫黏、把鋼絞線折線配置，或在頂部配置黏結鋼筋。工廠品質管理還包括放鬆強度試體、尺寸與預埋件位置、反拱量測與端部裂縫檢查，PCI 設有工廠認證制度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「放鬆時端部應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strand release is one of the most critical moments for a double tee: concrete strength is still low, and while self-weight moment at midspan offsets prestress eccentricity, near the ends there is no self-weight moment, so bottom compression and top tension are both greatest. If top tension exceeds its limit the flange cracks, so some strands are debonded at the ends, strands are harped, or bonded top reinforcement is added. Plant quality control also covers release-strength cylinders, dimensions and embed positions, camber measurement and end-crack inspection, and PCI runs a plant certification programme. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Transfer stress at ends” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力梁最危險的狀態是滿載使用時，放鬆時不需要特別檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A prestressed member is most at risk under full service load, so release needs no special checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「放鬆時端部應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Transfer stress at ends”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer checks and plant quality control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「放鬆時端部應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer stress at ends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁端（無自重彎矩）：σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa，小於 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa（f'ci = 30 MPa）；σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa 拉應力，大於 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，須脫黏、折線或配頂部鋼筋。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the ends, with no self-weight moment: σ_bot = −P/A − P·e/S_b = −2,016,000/450,000 − 2,016,000×408/5.92×10⁷ ≈ −4.48 − 13.90 ≈ −18.4 MPa, within 0.70 f'ci = 21.0 MPa for f'ci = 30 MPa; σ_top = −4.48 + 2,016,000×408/1.03×10⁸ ≈ +3.5 MPa tension, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so debonding, harping or top reinforcement is required. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一床位放鬆前以同條件養護的圓柱試體確認 f'ci 達到規定值，記錄放鬆順序與時間；放鬆後檢查端部與翼板裂縫、量測反拱，並抽查尺寸、預埋件與吊點位置是否在容許誤差內，結果與構件編號一併歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before release on each bed, confirm f'ci from cylinders cured with the product, and record the release sequence and time; afterwards inspect ends and flanges for cracks, measure camber and spot-check dimensions, embeds and lifting points against tolerances, filing results with the member mark.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現場載重試驗」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-situ load test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當雙 T 梁在運輸、吊裝或使用中受損，或屋頂要增加超出原設計的荷載，而計算無法確認安全時，可做現場載重試驗：以水袋或砂包分級加載，量測跨中撓度、裂縫與卸載後的回復。預力構件在未開裂時撓度接近線性且回復良好，若加載過程撓度突然增加或回復不足，代表已開裂或預力鋼絞線受損。試驗本身有風險，必須事先設計荷載級距、停止條件與安全支撐。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現場載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a double tee has been damaged in transport, erection or service, or a roof must carry more load than designed and calculation cannot confirm safety, an in-situ load test may be used: water bags or sandbags are added in stages while midspan deflection, cracking and recovery after unloading are measured. Uncracked prestressed members deflect almost linearly and recover well; a sudden jump in deflection or poor recovery signals cracking or strand damage. Testing itself carries risk, so load increments, stop criteria and safety shoring must be designed beforehand. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “In-situ load test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 現場撓度量測與載重試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field deflection survey and load testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現場載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-situ load test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ACI 318 載重試驗的撓度門檻 l_t²/(20,000·h) 檢核：跨度 l_t = 24,000 mm、梁深 h = 800 mm，門檻 = 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm。若試驗荷載下最大撓度 30 mm，小於 36 mm，可直接判定撓度合格；若超過，則需檢查卸載後的回復比例。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Check against the ACI 318 load-test deflection threshold l_t²/(20,000·h): with span l_t = 24,000 mm and depth h = 800 mm, the threshold is 24,000²/(20,000×800) = 36 mm. A maximum deflection of 30 mm under test load is below 36 mm and passes directly; if exceeded, recovery after unloading must be checked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫列出試驗荷載、分級、每級持載時間、量測點（跨中與支承沉陷）、停止條件與安全支撐，由結構技師核可並在場監督；結果與預測撓度比較，並記錄裂縫圖與卸載回復，作為是否限制使用或補強的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan sets test load, increments, hold time per stage, measurement points at midspan and supports, stop criteria and safety shoring, approved and supervised on site by the structural engineer; compare results with predicted deflection and record crack maps and recovery as the basis for use restrictions or strengthening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
