steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Roof waterproofing, joints and connector corrosion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋面接縫防水」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof joint waterproofing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 無面層的雙 T 梁屋頂有大量翼板接縫，接縫密封與防水層一旦失效，雨水會沿接縫滲入，直接接觸焊接連接器、預埋鋼件與承壓區。連接器多為外露鋼板，在潮濕與乾濕循環下腐蝕，斷面減少使隔板傳力能力下降；承壓區長期潮濕則使缺口端部鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落。屋面維護因此不只是防漏，而是保護結構連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋面接縫防水」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An untopped double-tee roof has many flange joints, and once joint sealants and membrane fail, rain runs into the joints and onto welded connectors, embedded steel and bearing areas. Connectors are usually exposed steel plates that corrode under wetting and drying, losing section and diaphragm capacity; persistently damp bearing areas rust dap reinforcement and spall concrete. Roof maintenance is therefore not only about leaks but about protecting structural connections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Roof joint waterproofing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂漏水只是防水問題，不會影響雙 T 梁的結構安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Roof leaks are only a waterproofing issue and do not affect the structural safety of double tees." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 屋面防水、接縫與連接器腐蝕：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 mm 厚連接器鋼板若在潮濕接縫中每側年腐蝕 0.1 mm，20 年後減少 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm，約 40% 斷面；原容量 60 kN 降為約 36 kN，對 29.5 kN 的需求只剩約 22% 餘裕，再過幾年便不足。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 10 mm connector plate corroding 0.1 mm per side per year in a wet joint loses 2×0.1×20 = 4 mm, about 40% of its section, after 20 years; capacity falls from 60 kN to about 36 kN, leaving only about 22% margin over the 29.5 kN demand, and a few more years make it inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查屋面防水層、接縫密封與排水口，雨後從下方檢查翼板接縫滲水痕跡與連接器鏽蝕；抽樣清除連接器表面量測剩餘厚度，承壓區以目視與敲擊檢查剝落，結果與前次紀錄比較。

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂開孔與增設設備」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof openings and added equipment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何開孔或增設荷載前，以竣工圖確認鋼絞線位置，必要時以鋼筋掃描在現場標示腹肋與鋼絞線，結構技師檢核強度與使用性後才可施工；移除構件須有經設計的臨時支撐與千斤頂計畫，並設停止點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before any opening or added load, locate strands from as-built drawings and mark stems and strands on site by scanning where needed, and proceed only after the structural engineer checks strength and serviceability; removing members needs an engineered temporary support and jacking plan with hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含雙 T 梁配置與編號圖、鋼絞線位置、允許開孔區、允許附加荷載、連接器與承壓檢查紀錄，並在屋頂入口與腹肋上標示「預力構件，禁止切割鑽孔」；移除或搬移構件須經結構技師設計臨時支撐並核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the tee layout and marks, strand locations, permitted opening zones, allowable added loads and connector and bearing inspection records, with ‘prestressed member: do not cut or drill’ labels at roof access and on stems; removing or relocating members requires temporary supports designed and approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 改裝、開孔、移除與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alterations, openings, removal and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂開孔與增設設備」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof openings and added equipment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 承包商不知道腹肋內有預力鋼絞線，為穿管在腹肋鑽孔或切割，切斷鋼絞線後構件突然開裂下垂；移除構件時臨時支撐的頂部鋼梁或斜撐不足，像 Montgomery Mall 事故一樣在重新頂升時失穩倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A contractor unaware of strands in the stems drills or cuts a stem for pipework, severing strands so the member suddenly cracks and sags; temporary towers with inadequate top beams or bracing during removal become unstable and collapse on re-jacking, as at Montgomery Mall. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：移除或搬移既有雙 T 梁同樣危險：職業安全衛生署調查的 2013 年 Montgomery Mall 事故，是以千斤頂與滑移方式移除一片長約 60 ft、重約 42,800 lb 的雙 T 梁時，臨時支撐塔頂部鋼梁受壓挫屈，造成一死一傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Removing or relocating existing tees is equally hazardous: in the 2013 Montgomery Mall incident investigated by OSHA, a tee about 60 ft long weighing about 42,800 lb was being removed by jacking and skating when the top beam of a temporary safety tower buckled, killing one worker and injuring another.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙 T 梁腹肋鑽個小孔穿管線不會影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drilling a small hole through a double-tee stem for services does not affect the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
